title: Playboy Magazine September 1963 Richard Burton Interview Kenneth Tynan Ray
conditionDescription: Light toning and edge wear, small corner chips and creasing, light spine rubbing. Covers attached, spine intact, complete. Centerfold not separately verified.
descriptionText:
Playboy Magazine, September 1963 issue. Cover price 75 cents. Interview with Richard Burton by Kenneth Tynan; "The Relationship" by Jules Feiffer; "The Businessman at Bay" by J. Paul Getty; Playboy's Pigskin Preview; "The Life Work of Juan Diaz" by Ray Bradbury; "Ah, Women, Women" by Alberto Moravia; and the 14-page European portfolio. Black-frame cover with the shadow-puppet brunette. Back cover carries a 1963 Haig & Haig Scotch ad.

Condition: Good for its age - light toning and edge wear, small chips and creasing at the corners, and light spine rubbing (see close-ups). Both covers attached, spine intact, complete. The centerfold has not been separately verified - please ask before buying if that matters to you. Please review all photos - they are of the actual copy you will receive.
